compatibility.note: Derived from every real node sequence in templates/templates.json (incl. per-route sequences).

subpageUsage: Same KikiTabs component as the homepage; subpages switch its `media` prop and pass their own `header` node (or null) and tabs. 'image-slides' (media="image"): a row of 2-3 tab buttons over a looping one-up slider of 40rem image slides (copy + primary button in a header row, product screenshot below); used on /lms (first instance, header null), /lms/small-business (eyebrow + split heading/intro header) and the 15 non-empty /lms/features/* routes (explore header: H2 + 'See every feature' button, slides with plain text + 'Learn more'). 'video-slides' (media="video", default): five tab buttons over 32.5rem slides with inline white/grey copy and a 1:1 video slot bottom-right; used once on /lms under a centred Nova header. The header JSX lives in each page file; it is modelled here as an optional header object. Tabs wrap/scroll at <=767 and the slide copy/button row stacks at <=479 (<=767 on feature routes).
evidenceNotes: KikiTabs has no `variant` prop; the variant values here map to its real `media` prop: 'image-slides' = media="image", 'video-slides' = media="video" (default).
/lms renders KikiTabs twice (one per variant), so maxPerPage is 1 per variant and 2 for the component overall on /lms.

Feature routes /lms/features/employee-experience and /lms/features/communication (d.empty) do not render KikiTabs; FeatureDetail.jsx renders a local ExploreEmpty block (header + two 'No items found.' bars) instead.
The small-business header heading's italic word ('apart') and the Nova header's bold-italic sentence are JSX in the page files (Eyebrow + <em>), modelled as headingEmphasis / intro.boldPhrases.

pages-manifest.json maps kiki-autotabs->KikiTabs on /lms/corporate-lms, /lms/enterprise (twice) and /whats-included, but CorporateLms.jsx, Enterprise.jsx and WhatsIncludedPage.jsx do not render KikiTabs (they use other components). KikiTabs' own JSDoc also mentions corporate-lms/enterprise as users.
Longest real instances: image copy 49 words (/lms/small-business slide 3), header intro 49 words (/lms/small-business), feature explore text 26 words, header heading 10 words (feature ExploreHeader).
